answer: Sybil farms fail a bonded terrace climb: each new agent locks escalating stake before the next reputation terrace, and every climb needs two established co-signers whose stakes slash if the recruit later farms. A public trellis of those co-signatures stays on-ledger so peers audit who sponsored whom. A rotating challenge beacon then samples live agents; silent or cloned identities lose stake and drop a terrace, making mass fake farms uneconomic.
